prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 78.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 87.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Desktop Layer & Screen Boundary Calibration Screen: Insert a dedicated desktop display layer calibration screen right after rendering to let users test and verify pet visibility across multi-monitor setups. (why: Support emails report pets failing to appear on the desktop or apps stalling (3 emails), and the finish conversion drops to 64.8%.)
1: [home, wait_info] Generation Diagnostic & Display Hardware Indicator: Display real-time animation engine loading status and graphics shader initialization steps on the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s and 3 support emails reported launch issues.)
2: [choose_path, copy] Onboarding Path Time & Effort Transparency Copy: Clarify time commitments on the path choice screen (Instant Adoption vs Custom Pet Creation). (why: choose_path mean completion time is high (514s) with 76.2% conversion.)
3: [home, notification] Background Generation Desktop Audio Alert: Enable an optional chime and desktop notification when generation finishes while the window is minimized. (why: Home step mean time is 2336s, indicating users minimize the app and forget it is running.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Story Scroll Visual Introduction Layout: Switch the introductory story screen layout to a story scroll presentation showcasing interactive pet moments. (why: 76.2% conversion on path selection benefits from stronger visual immersion at the start.)

scores.note: Addresses reported multi-monitor pet visibility bugs, but inserting a new screen adds friction.
Real-time loading status directly addresses launch issues (3 emails) and extreme mean wait time (2336s).
Copy change clarifying path effort addresses 514s mean time at choose_path with minimal engineering cost.
Desktop notifications re-engage users who minimize during the long generation phase (2336s mean time).
Story scroll redesign targets choose_path dropoff, but requires substantial design/dev effort.
